trap.label: expected to
trap.wrong: Three clinics are expected close next year.
trap.right: Three clinics are expected to close next year.
trap.why: Em português “espera-se que fechem”. Em inglês, são expected + to + base; não esqueça o to.

mcq.q: It is ___ that 12,000 will lose care.
The plan is expected ___ in June.

opts: It is expected that three clinics will close.

fix.right: Three clinics are expected to close.

fix.wrong: It is estimate that 12,000 will lose care.
fix.right: It is estimated that 12,000 will lose care.

fix.wrong: The plan is expected starts in June.
fix.right: The plan is expected to start in June.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “Experts expect three clinics to close.”
rewrite.answer: Three clinics are expected to close.

rewrite.prompt: Com It: “Experts estimate that 12,000 will lose care.”
rewrite.answer: It is estimated that 12,000 will lose care.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “People expect the plan to start in June.”
rewrite.answer: The plan is expected to start in June.
